Return channel breaks: execute, preflight and the fixer resume from fix's in-session return, and execute forbids waiting on a completion notification; team agents in terminal panes are not children, so no completion re-invokes the waiting session unless an external wake (watchdog or tracked job) delivers the team's OUTCOME.

Diagnose split breaks: diagnose keeps hypothesise-instrument-conclude inline because each step needs the previous one's texture, and DELEGATION forbids delegating accumulated-nuance loops; spreading that loop over planners, builder and verifier contradicts both.
Bug-fixer grants do not reach pane agents: the write-only-in-worktree scope grant and the Maven lock rule live in the fixer's prompt; agents started in their own panes do not read it.

Autopilot park leaves team agents alive: a timed-out or vanished subtask subagent is parked and its task stopped, but stopping a task leaves its processes alive, so team panes started from it keep editing the worktree after the park.

Model pin breaks: the implementation-tier pin travels only through the agent definition and must never be passed as a model argument; a builder started as a CLI in a pane has no agent definition, so it must be given the model some other way.
